label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value 'bar' is derived from user-supplied 'param' (via Referer header). Although 'doSomething' replaces the last character of 'param' with 'Z', the preceding characters remain attacker-controlled, allowing potential XSS payloads in the response body. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): alert-TP — resolved sink value 'bar' is derived from user-supplied 'param'. Passing attacker-controlled data to PrintWriter.format() exposes the application to format string vulnerabilities. Both alerts indicate unsafe data flow to the sink.

evidence.note: User input extracted from Referer header into 'param' and URL-decoded.
'bar' initialized from 'param'; modified only by replacing last char with 'Z', leaving prefix attacker-controlled.
Sink: 'bar' passed to writer().format(), writing attacker-controlled content to HTML response.
